import numpy as np, json
def f(P):
    arr=np.array(P); nz=(arr!=0)
    r0=int(nz.min(axis=0)[0]); c0=int(nz.min(axis=0)[1]); r1=int(nz.max(axis=0)[0]); c1=int(nz.max(axis=0)[1])
    b=arr[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; n=b.shape[0]
    return [[int(b[min(i,j)%n][min(i,j)%n]) for j in range(2*n)] for i in range(2*n)]
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
